MP1
Apparatus:
method of heating water and timer
MP2
Method:
measure the temperature of the water and place the ice cube(s) in the water and measure the time taken to melt
MP3
repeat with water at different temperature(s)
MP4, MP5
Key variables:
Any two from:
mass / volume of ice cubes
number / size of ice cubes (per test)
temperature of ice cubes / keep ice cubes in a freezer
room temperature
volume of water in the beaker
amount of stirring
MP6
Table:
table with columns for time / t and water temperature with correct units
MP7
Conclusion:
explanation of how to reach a conclusion
